definitions: A fleet of ships, often older and less regulated, used to transport goods (such as oil) for entities seeking to circumvent international sanctions or regulations.
A clandestine or unofficial group of vessels operating outside conventional maritime oversight.
examples: The shadow fleet expanded significantly after the new sanctions were imposed.
Concerns were raised about the environmental risks posed by the aging vessels in the shadow fleet.
Tracking the shadow fleet proved challenging due to their use of deceptive shipping practices.
